blocks.label: How it works
blocks.title: From your lot to your keys, in five steps
blocks.text: You never have to manage subcontractors or chase permits. Here is what building on your land with Riverstone looks like.
items: Building consultation
Sit down with our team to talk through your land, budget, plan ideas and timeline before you commit to anything.
Choose your plan
Pick one of our proven floor plans or bring your own, then make it yours with your layout changes and selections.
Permits and site prep
We handle permitting, HOA approval and getting your lot ready to build.
Construction
Our project manager runs the job site from the foundation to the final finish, and keeps you updated along the way.
Walk-through and closing
We walk the home with you, finish the punch list and see you through closing.

blocks.label: Questions
blocks.title: Building on your land: common questions
items: Can you build on land I already own?
Yes. We build custom homes on our clients' lots and handle permits, planning and construction from start to finish.
Can I bring my own plan?
Yes. You can start from one of our proven plans or bring your own, and we'll fit it to your lot. We regularly customize layouts, finishes and outdoor spaces.
Where do you build?
Throughout North Metro Atlanta and North Georgia, including Cherokee, Bartow, Gordon, Cobb and Pickens counties. If you're not sure your lot is in our area, call us at 706-514-6637.
What comes standard?
Every Riverstone home includes LVP flooring in the main living areas, granite or quartz countertops, custom cabinetry, tiled baths and more. See the full Standard Features list.
How do I pick my finishes?
After your plan is set, we walk you through your selections, from exterior colors and stone to cabinets, flooring and fixtures, with clear deadlines so construction stays on schedule.
I don't have land yet. Where do I start?
Start with us. Sandra Watkins of RE/MAX Town & Country specializes in lots and new construction and can help you find the right place first. Call or text her at 770-324-3680.

blocks.label: Barndominiums
blocks.title: Barndominiums built for North Georgia land.
blocks.lede: Open, barn-style living with room for a shop, horses or equipment, built by a local team that has been building since 1997.

blocks.label: Why a barndominium
blocks.title: Living space and work space under one roof.
paras: A barndominium gives you a home and a working building in one: big open living areas, a loft if you want one, and space for a shop, vehicles, tools or animals.

They're a natural fit for North Georgia acreage, and we can build one on land you already own. If you'd rather keep the shop separate, we also build detached garages, workshops and pole barns to match.

blocks.label: Questions
blocks.title: Barndominium questions
items: Can you build a barndominium on my land?
Yes. We build on our clients' land and handle permits, planning and construction from start to finish.
Can I add a separate shop or pole barn?
Yes. Along with barndominiums we build detached garages, workshops and pole barns for vehicles, tools, hay or storage.
Where do you build?
Throughout North Metro Atlanta and North Georgia, including Cherokee, Bartow, Gordon, Cobb and Pickens counties.
Where do I start?
Book a building consultation. You'll get honest advice from a builder who's been doing this since 1997, whether you build with us or not. Call 706-514-6637.
